item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 28/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise gradually over the coast of southern China in the next few days. However, upper-air disturbances will bring showers to the region. Under the influence of a humid southerly airstream, it will be misty in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring slightly cooler weather to Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
